split_protocol: CF9 anchored split: first 9 trading days train; 10th day held-out test

parameters.psi_bins: train decile edges with duplicate edges removed; exact full-split counts; 0.5-bin smoothing

limitations: All predictors are already normalized; values are interpreted only in standardized units.
KS statistics use deterministic random samples for bounded runtime and are not accompanied by p-values.
PSI depends on train-derived bins and is a descriptive heuristic, not a hypothesis test.
Correlation and condition diagnostics describe association, not causality or predictive usefulness.
The CSVs contain no stock identifier or timestamp columns, so stock/day-segmented drift cannot be recovered here.
Engineered members use family-relative names unless individual flat-CSV ordering is independently verified.
